svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 254 · HEALTHCARE, CLINICAL EHR (HL7 FHIR) & CLAIMS AI SECURITY FAQ
Healthcare, Clinical EHR (HL7 FHIR) & Claims AI Security: SMART on FHIR + HIPAA De-ID + Broker
Preventing Cross-Patient PHI Snooping, Phase-III Clinical Trial Unblinding, Referral Prompt Injection & Specialty-Drug Claims Fraud
536 Scenarios · 1,138 Assertions · 522 Vectors
BRK-517 & BRK-518 · SMART on FHIR + Broker
1. Healthcare Clinical EHR & Payer Claims AI Security Architecture Matrix
🔵 SMART on FHIR Patient Pinning
Azure Health Data Services (launch/patient)
• Pitfall: Hospital-wide service account queries all
• Fix: Bind OAuth JWT to single encounter patient_id
• Hardening: Strip patient_id from LLM tool schema
Architect Verdict:
Mandatory for outpatient clinical copilots;
physically blocks cross-patient VIP chart snooping!
🟣 HIPAA 18-Identifier De-ID
Azure Health De-ID Service / Presidio
• Mode: Surrogate replacement for names/MRN/SSN
• Date Shift: Preserves exact day/hour intervals
• Scope: RWE cohort matching, evals & trace logs
Architect Verdict:
Satisfies HIPAA Safe Harbor while preserving
longitudinal timeline reasoning for LLMs.
🟠 Groundedness & Draft-Only Orders
Clinical Fact Verification + status="draft"
• Risk: Hallucinated allergies or drug dosages
• Check: Verify against source FHIR Observations
• Rule: AI writes draft orders only; MD signs
Architect Verdict:
Never allow an AI agent to commit active
MedicationRequest orders without MD sign-off!
🛡️ Deterministic Capability Broker
Blocking Referral Injection & Claims Fraud
• G1 (Trial Lock): record-owner guards blinding DB
• G2 (Network Lock): Protects provider registry
• G3 (Claims Gate): Blocks $4,960 wires in 0.0248ms
Production Reference Verdict:
Tag external referrals & claims untrusted
to block 100% of automated claim wire fraud!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: FHIR Referral Trial Unblinding & Claims Fraud vs. SMART on FHIR + Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Shared FHIR Service Account + Auto-Payout (BRK-517 / BRK-518 Breach)
1. Referral Injection & Trial Unblinding (BRK-517): External HL7 FHIR referral coerces Agent
to read Phase-III blinding schedule restricted-budget, alter diagnosis & export PHI.
2. Out-of-Network Claims Fraud (BRK-518): Forged specialty-drug claim whitelists external
pharmacy in trust-registry and executes $4,960 direct-pay claim wire!
💥 Root Cause: Unscoped FHIR access & allowing untrusted claim attachments to trigger payouts!
✅ Hardened Clinical & Claims Stack: SMART on FHIR + De-ID + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (launch/patient + record-owner): Pins single patient & blocks trial-blinding reads
• Gate 2 (Draft-Only + untrusted-write): Blocks external referrals from mutating diagnoses
• Gate 3 (fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry in-network provider lists
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks claim-induced $4,960 payout wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Healthcare, Clinical EHR & Medical Claims AI Production Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. Enforce SMART on FHIR launch/patient: Strip patient_id from tool schemas and inject from encounter JWT
☑️ 2. Air-Gap Clinical Trial Blinding Tables: Block outpatient agents from reading restricted-budget schedules
☑️ 3. HIPAA 18-Identifier Surrogate De-ID: Run Azure Health De-ID with uniform date-shifting on RWE & logs
☑️ 4. Mandate status="draft" Orders ☑️ 5. Enable Clinical Groundedness ☑️ 6. Lock Provider Registry & Claim Wires
